$comment: CENTRAL SELECTOR REGISTRY -- the single source of truth for every ChatGPT DOM locator.
HARD RULE: no selector may appear anywhere else. Not in the Supervisor prompt, not in
adapter/*.js, not in one-off shell commands. If a page change breaks something, exactly
one file gets edited. selector-audit.ps1 enforces this mechanically.
candidate  -- plausible from documented semantics, NOT yet verified on the live page.
verified   -- confirmed against the real logged-in page during PHASE 3.
fallback   -- kept because a verified selector may regress; tried after verified ones.
rejected   -- observed on the real page but unusable (ambiguous / unstable / absent).
RESOLUTION: candidates are tried in array order; the first that matches wins, so
ordering encodes preference. PHASE 3 winners are moved to the front and marked verified.
ENCODING: this file intentionally contains Chinese strings, because the ChatGPT UI
language follows the account locale and this deployment renders zh-CN. It must only
ever be written through UTF-8-safe tooling -- a Windows PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content
round-trip uses the ANSI code page and destroys these strings irrecoverably.
WHAT TO AVOID (enforced by selector-audit): no nth-child, no generated class hashes, no
coordinate-based targeting, no deep descendant chains.

input.purpose: The message composer. A contenteditable ProseMirror div, NOT a textarea.

candidates.note: PHASE 3: matched=1 visible=1; tag=div, class=ProseMirror, contenteditable=true
PHASE 3: matched=1 -- survives an id change

candidates.name: 与 ChatGPT 聊天
candidates.note: aria-label on the live page (zh-CN UI)

sendButton.purpose: Commits the composer contents as a user turn. EXISTS ONLY WHILE THE COMPOSER IS NON-EMPTY -- an empty composer renders no submit control at all.

candidates.note: PHASE 3: appears only after text is entered; type=submit, aria-label=发送提示词

sendButton.verify: absent on an empty composer, present and enabled once text is entered

stopButton.purpose: PRIMARY 'still generating' signal. Present while streaming, absent once the turn settles.

candidates.note: must be confirmed during an actual stream; not observable while idle

stopButton.verify: appears during generation and disappears on completion -- BOTH transitions must be observed

roleTextboxGroup.purpose: TAG CATEGORY (not an element selector): the tag set that can carry a textbox role.

roleButtonGroup.purpose: TAG CATEGORY (not an element selector): the tag set that can carry a button role.

roleLinkGroup.purpose: TAG CATEGORY (not an element selector): the tag set that can carry a link role.

streamingHint.purpose: Cheap secondary probe for 'still generating', combined with the stop button. Deliberately redundant so a single UI change cannot flip completion detection.

stripFromVisibleText.purpose: Non-content nodes removed from a cloned document before its visible text is read. Without this, SVG path data and script/style bodies would pollute every text-based state match.

stripFromBody.purpose: UI chrome removed from a cloned assistant body before its text is extracted, so toolbars, copy/regenerate buttons and menu text cannot enter the transcript.

candidates.note: PHASE 3: matched=2 on a live 1-user/1-assistant conversation
PHASE 3: matched=0 - this UI revision does not use article[data-testid]
PHASE 3: matched=1 visible=1; turn is a div carrying data-message-id and data-message-model-slug

assistantBody.purpose: The readable markdown body INSIDE an assistant turn. Scoping to this avoids pulling toolbars, buttons and menu text into the transcript.

candidates.note: PHASE 3: matched inside both turns; extracted 3217 chars from the live reply with formatting intact
last resort: the turn container's own text

newChat.purpose: Starts a fresh conversation (worker creation / rotation).
newChat.verify: clicking it lands on a URL that is NOT /c/<id>

blockingStateText.$comment: STATE DETECTION BY VISIBLE TEXT, not by selector. These states change copy often and have no reliable DOM anchor, so they are matched against visible page text. Patterns are BILINGUAL because the ChatGPT UI language follows the account/locale, not the adapter -- a Chinese-locale signed-out page says the equivalent of 'log in', not 'Log in'.

loginRequired.purpose: Session expired or never established. Adapter must STOP; it never attempts to authenticate.
patterns: 使用 Google 账户继续
使用 Apple 账户继续

captcha.purpose: Human verification. Adapter must STOP immediately and hand off to the human.

rateLimit.purpose: Usage cap or throttling. Adapter must STOP rather than retry into a wall.

error.purpose: Copy used to DESCRIBE an error to a human. Deliberately broad, and therefore NOT safe as an abort trigger.

errorFatal.purpose: STRICT abort triggers: phrases that ONLY appear when generation genuinely failed. Kept separate from `error` because broad copy catches normal UI -- a live run was wrongly aborted by the single word meaning 'retry', which ChatGPT also renders in ordinary chrome. Aborting a valid answer is a worse failure than missing a rare error, so this list stays narrow.

contextWarning.purpose: Context-pressure signals; feed the Worker Rotation decision.

discovery.$comment: Hints for the PHASE 3 probe. These are NOT selectors used by the adapter -- they only tell the probe which attribute families are worth dumping so real anchors can be found.
